Publishes releases to GitHub using the generated SemRel tag, version, and changelog. It supports draft and prerelease flags and can upload matching assets from the local workspace.

## Installation

### Binary

```bash
semrel plugin install @semrel/provider-github
```

`semrel plugin install` downloads the binary to `.semrel/plugins/` and updates `.semrel.lock`. Commit `.semrel.lock` to pin the version for your team.


### Docker

Pre-built, signed multi-platform images (linux/amd64, linux/arm64) are published on every release:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/semrels/provider-github:latest
```

Verify the image signature with cosign:

```bash
cosign verify ghcr.io/semrels/provider-github:latest \
  --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/SemRels/provider-github/.github/workflows/release.yml.*' \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
```
## Configuration

```yaml
version: 1
plugins:
  - uses: @semrel/provider-github
    args:
      # token is read from SEMREL_PLUGIN_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN env var
      owner: SemRels
      repo: semrel
      draft: false
      prerelease: false
      assets: 'dist/*.tar.gz,dist/*.zip'
      comment_on_prs: "true"
```

## Environment Variables

| Name | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_TOKEN` | yes | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub token used to create the release (falls back to `GITHUB_TOKEN`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_OWNER` | no | `current repository owner` | Repository owner or organization. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_REPO` | no | `current repository name` | Repository name to publish into. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BASE_URL` | no | `https://api.github.com` | GitHub API base URL override (supports GHES `/api/v3` and `*.ghe.com`; falls back to `SEMREL_PLUGIN_API_URL` and `GITHUB_API_URL`). |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_API_URL` | no | `https://api.github.com` | Alias for `SEMREL_PLUGIN_BASE_URL`. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_CA_CERT` | no | `—` | Path to a PEM-encoded custom CA certificate bundle for internal/self-signed GHES instances. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY` | no | `false` | Skip TLS certificate verification (`true`/`1`). Use only as a last resort. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_DRAFT` | no | `false` | Create the release as a draft. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_PRERELEASE` | no | `false` | Mark the release as a prerelease. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_ASSETS` | no | `—` | Comma-separated file paths or glob patterns for release assets to upload. |
| `SEMREL_PLUGIN_COMMENT_ON_PRS` | no | `true` | Automatically post an idempotent release comment on merged pull requests included in the release (`SEMREL_COMMIT_HASHES`). |

## Release Context Variables

- `SEMREL_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_TAG_NAME`
- `SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_CURRENT_VERSION`
- `SEMREL_CHANGELOG`
- `SEMREL_COMMIT_HASHES`
- `SEMREL_DRY_RUN`

## Behavior

For `v1.4.0`, the provider creates a GitHub release, attaches files matching `SEMREL_PLUGIN_ASSETS`, publishes the SemRel changelog as release notes, and comments on merged pull requests included in the release with a link to the new release. Works out of the box with GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) and Data Residency (`*.ghe.com`).
